title: Jezero crater – western delta front (HiRISE 1 m)
description: ~0.95 km² of the western Jezero delta front (Hawksbill Gap / Enchanted Lake / Three Forks), Mars. Native USGS HiRISE 1 m DTM samples with Horn slope and plane-residual roughness. Real Mars data.

crs.description: Mars 2000 sphere (R=3396190 m), Equirectangular lat_ts=0 lon_0=0 (USGS Mars2020 TRN grid); local frame = ground metres from SW corner, east scaled by cos(18.456°)

localOriginInSource.units: m (source Equirectangular x/y of the SW outer corner; east_m = (x - x0)*cos(lat_c), north_m = y - y0)

crs.verticalReference: Metres as distributed in the USGS Mars 2020 TRN DTMs (file names 'MOLAtopography_DeltaGeoid'); empirically equal to JPL rover 'elev_geoid' (median diff -0.006 m over 62 waypoints) -> areoid-referenced (MOLA-style). USGS XML text mentions the IAU 2000 sphere; exact datum wording is a producer ambiguity. Negative values are normal (Jezero floor ~ -2.5 km).

elevation.definition: Native HiRISE 1 m DTM samples copied 1:1 (no resampling) at cell centres; NaN = source NoData. Vertical reference: see crs.verticalReference.

slope.definition: Horn (1981) 3x3 finite differences on ground spacing (dx = 0.94857 m, dy = 1 m), computed on a 250 m margin then cropped; degrees, 0 = flat.

roughness.definition: RMS residual after least-squares plane fit over 5x5 cells (4.74 m E x 5 m N ground); NaN where the window is incomplete.

quality.definition: 0 no elevation; 3 unknown for every valid cell. The USGS DTM mosaic publishes NO per-pixel quality/figure-of-merit layer, only global statistics (see limitations); no per-pixel quality was invented. Codes 1/2 unused.

exclusion.definition: 0 none, 1 missing elevation, 2 unsupported derivative (3x3 slope or roughness window incomplete), 3 outside source extent, 4 manual (none applied in this version). Slope limits are NOT baked in (route model profile).

qualityClasses.label: Unknown quality (no per-pixel quality published)
sourceCategories: USGS DTM mosaic valid sample without per-pixel figure-of-merit

pointsOfInterest.name: Delta front – Skinner Ridge / Wildcat Ridge (Hawksbill Gap ascent)
pointsOfInterest.purpose: Western delta front (lower delta sedimentary rocks). Cores Swift Run/Skyland (Skinner Ridge, sols 490/495); Hazeltop/Bearwallow (Wildcat Ridge, sols 509/516). VR stop: Mastcam-Z 360° panoramas Mastcam-Z 360 #19 Skinner Ridge, Mastcam-Z 360 #20 Wildcat Ridge, Mastcam-Z 360 #18 High-res Rockytop scarp (credit NASA/JPL-Caltech/ASU/MSSS). Position = JPL rover waypoint sol 502 site 26 drive 1222 (where the panorama was taken); the named outcrop may be metres to tens of metres away.

pointsOfInterest.name: Delta front base – Enchanted Lake / Amalik / Hidden Harbor
pointsOfInterest.purpose: Base of western delta front. Cores Shuyak/Mageik (Amalik, sols 575/619), Kukaklek (Hidden Harbor, 631); regolith Atmo Mountain/Crosswind Lake (634/639). VR stop: Mastcam-Z 360° panoramas Mastcam-Z 360 #21 Enchanted Lake, Mastcam-Z 360 #22 Hidden Harbor workspace, Enchanted Lake mosaic (partial) (credit NASA/JPL-Caltech/ASU/MSSS). Position = JPL rover waypoint sol 565 site 29 drive 0 (where the panorama was taken); the named outcrop may be metres to tens of metres away.

pointsOfInterest.name: Three Forks Sample Depot
pointsOfInterest.purpose: Crater floor at foot of delta front. 10 sample tubes deposited on the surface (depot, Dec 2022–Jan 2023). VR stop: Mastcam-Z 360° panoramas Mastcam-Z 360 #24 Three Forks Depot #2 (all samples), Mastcam-Z 360 #23 Depot #1 (credit NASA/JPL-Caltech/ASU/MSSS). Position = JPL rover waypoint sol 686 site 32 drive 1184 (where the panorama was taken); the named outcrop may be metres to tens of metres away.

limitations: Equirectangular source (lat_ts=0): projected E-W metres were converted to ground metres with cos(lat_c)=0.948567; cells are 0.94857 m (E) x 1.0 m (N).
No per-pixel quality layer exists in the USGS DTM mosaic: all valid cells are quality 3 (unknown); strict quality mode is not supported.
Producer statistics: HiRISE orthoimages co-registered < 3 m (99th pct); HiRISE vs CTX median vertical offset ~0.4 m (CTX above).
Vertical reference wording is ambiguous in USGS metadata (IAU sphere vs MOLA areoid); values match JPL areoid elevations within cm at science stops.
Science-stop names are informal Mars 2020 team names, not IAU-approved names.
Roughness is a detrended residual at 5 x 5 cells; it is not a rock-size or hazard map.
